quests.instruction: IDENTIFY THE INTONATION CONTOUR ENUNCIATED IN THE PHRASE
quests.hint: Listen to the ending of the sentence. Does the pitch drop or rise? (Calibration 111-1)
quests.explanation: Statements in English typically end with falling intonation (the pitch drops on the final word 'student').
